title: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:32172:20211130:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Appointment of Local Public Officials) <Presidential Decree No. 32172, November 30, 2021>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 13, 2022. <Proviso Omitted>

Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (12) Omitted.

(13) The Regulations on Establishment and Operation of Electronic Personnel Management Systems of Local Governments shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4 (1), "heads of local governments" shall be replaced with "heads of local governments and chairpersons of local councils (meaning the chairpersons of councils of Special Metropolitan Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Dos, or Special Self-Governing Provinces and of councils of Sis, Guns, or autonomous Gus; hereinafter the same shall apply)"; in the proviso to paragraph (2) of the same Article, "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council"; and in paragraphs (3) and (4) of the same Article, "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council," respectively.

In Article 5 (2), "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council."

In the main sentence of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6 (1), "to the head of a local government" shall be replaced with "to the head of a local government or chairperson of a local council," and "the head of the local government shall" shall be replaced with "the head of the local government and the chairperson of the local council shall"; and in paragraph (3) of the same Article, "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council."

In Article 7, "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council."

In Article 8, "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council."

In Article 9 (1) and (2), "head of a local government" shall be replaced with "head of a local government and chairperson of a local council," respectively.
